svg.text: Compact controller - Johnson states and conversion timing
5 negative-edge master/slave DFFs + 8 decision latches + 8 output latches | 424 expanded MOS
State string order: j0 j1 j2 j3 j4. q1...q9 are conceptual slot names; only q0 is a top-level marker.
track = NOR(j1,j4); cmpclk = phm AND !track. Interlocked phases close masters before slaves advance.
Idealized steady-state schedule: propagation and settling delays are omitted.
One conversion: 2 acquisition slots + 8 comparison slots = 50 ns. Outputs become stable after the following q0 fall.
v0 stays LOW; earlier decisions drive resolved CDAC flags. Bit latches are transparent only during their selected master-high phase.
Testbench: AVDD rises from 0 V in 0.2 ns (1.0 -> 1.2 ns); POR R*C=100 ns; first CLK rising edge at 200 ns.
This schedule illustrates source logic, not simulated waveforms. Runner samples output after q0 fall plus 1 ns; targets are not pass claims.
